title: Universal Ontology v1.0
description: Canonical 7-zone x 7-level ontology registry. Quran Inspired ALLAH my Beloved is a philosophical inspiration statement, not a technical or theological prescription.

levels.definition: Total managed boundary for the ontology instance.
Origin, generation, or establishment boundary of a modeled thing.
Governing arrangement, rule, or organizing structure.
The modeled state or world being represented.
A bounded class or sphere within the modeled reality.
A coherent environment or operationally meaningful whole.
A bounded subject, concern, or semantic area.
Coherent collection of related systems, products, or resources.
Ownership or governance boundary.
Group of participating people, agents, or stakeholders.
Bounded scope by place, partition, tenancy, or deployment locality.
Runtime, development, test, production, or other execution context.
Connected topology of participating resources.
Immediate contextual boundary required to interpret a resource.
Fundamental reason for existence.
Intended directed outcome or responsibility.
Concrete target that can be evaluated.
Coordinated body of related objectives or work.
Bounded initiative or engineering effort.
Delivered capability or user-facing result.
Coordinated set of capabilities operating as a whole.
Version-controlled artifact boundary.
Source-material boundary from which implementation can be derived.
Native implementation container such as crate, package, module root, command, or service.
Cohesive logical grouping inside a unit.
Coordinated structural part with a distinct responsibility.
Cohesive implementation part with a defined responsibility.
Addressable construct inside a component or structural scope.
Named or otherwise identifiable semantic reference.
Distinct thing represented in the model.
Characteristic, attribute, or measurable feature of an entity.
Semantic connection between identifiable resources.
Defined transformation or capability over inputs or state.
Reusable mapping or computational behavior with defined inputs and outputs.
Observable semantic effect of a resource or operation.
Condition of a resource at a point or interval.
Occurrence that can be observed or recorded.
Ongoing or ordered activity that transforms state or resources.
Ordered movement of control, data, or resources.
Change from one state to another.
An invoked or performed unit of work.
A concrete runtime realization of computation.
Machine- or runtime-level directive describing work to perform.
Syntactic or evaluable form that denotes computation or value.
Concrete result or literal datum with an interpretable type or meaning.
Encoded or structured information being stored, moved, or processed.
Lexical or protocol-level unit of representation.
Encoded character, code point, or character-level representation.
Single binary information unit.
